content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Manueline stonework that could make a sardine weep with joy."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A riverside fortress with waves and history crashing at its feet."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sleek art and river views, like a museum dipped in the Tagus."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Warehouse lanes full of prints, coffee steam and tiny shops."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander Alfama's tiled lanes and catch the laundry flapping like bunting."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The best free balcony in town, with the castle and river doing all the work."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Rummage for tiles, trinkets and the odd sardine tin treasure."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A proper bifana and a cold beer, no fuss and very Lisbon."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"A world-class collection in a garden setting; the Islamic art wing alone is worth the trip."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Calm courtyard and honest vegetarian plates, a gentle reset after the galleries."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old stone walls, peacocks, and the best postcard view over the red rooftops."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Clatter through the old quarters on a wooden bench; hold on around the curves."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Fragrant, filling and easy on the wallet; the naan disappears fast with five of you."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lantern-lit lanes and tiny bars; the night only really starts when the funicular stops."}]}
Alfama, museums, Belém, ocean wonders and a market — every must-do squeezed in, and grilled sardines every single night.
